name: run158_pattern_analysis

failure_modes.description: Tier 1 and Tier 2 dispatches fired before checking PA quota/availability. Same quota error returned both times.
failure_modes.fix: Preflight: hit PA health endpoint once before dispatch. If 5031, immediately switch to local script execution. Do not retry identical failing dispatch.

failure_modes.description: Routing to external worker before reading local canonical script. Contract explicitly says single-mode execution with RISE/DEATH split removed.
failure_modes.fix: Rule: canonical script is the first execution path. External dispatch only after local script is proven unavailable or quota-exhausted.

failure_modes.description: Initiated /PhoenixScout and expand Canon before reading BACKBURNER. Contract §6 says backburner always takes precedence.
failure_modes.fix: Every new thread must call BACKBURNER read first. If any OPEN/BLOCKED item exists, pause new work and surface backburner.

failure_modes.description: Previous workflows used aggregate SOULCOUNT. User explicitly deprecated this. Per-session SOUL is the only valid metric.
failure_modes.fix: Remove all references to aggregate SOULCOUNT from RISE/reporting. Replace with session-scoped SOUL audit from SOULaudit.

failure_modes.description: Current session JSONL missing from expected paths. User cannot get /SOULaudit receipts until write target is confirmed.
failure_modes.fix: Add SOULaudit capture to session contract: flush prompts immediately to session-{run}-prompts.jsonl with line-by-line receipts.

patterns_identified: PA is a convenience, not a requirement
Local script-first beats cloud-first for canonical contracts
Global aggregates are deprecated in favor of per-session evidence
